verdict.rationale: Secureframe ships its own built-in AI, Comply AI, which takes on specific delegated tasks: risk assessment from a risk description, policy drafting and revision, extracting answers from vendor documents, generating SSPs/POA&Ms, and auto-generating IaC fixes. These are scoped, feature-specific AI functions rather than a general in-product assistant you can hand arbitrary tasks to. The MCP server connects external assistants, so it is not built-in and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app conversational assistant, evidence of multi-step task delegation across the platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Comply AI for Risk automates the risk assessment workflow by producing inherent risk score, treatment, residual risk score, and justifications.
Leverage generative AI to save hours writing and refining policies with Comply AI for Policies.
Leverage Comply AI to automatically extract relevant answers to security review questions from vendor documents like SOC 2 reports and policies.
Leverage auto-generated fixes for infrastructure as code so you can easily copy, paste, and deploy fixes to your cloud environment.
